Output shell completion code for the specified shell (bash, zsh, fish).
The shell code must be evaluated to provide interactive completion of commands, resource types and names.

Examples:
  # Load completions into the current bash session
  slipway completion bash | source /dev/stdin

  # Install fish completions
  slipway completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/slipway.fish

Usage:
  slipway completion SHELL

Use "slipway --help" for a list of global options (applies to all commands).
